title: WPA band at McDonogh 37 and Sam Lee's circular breathing
summary: He heard the WPA band at his grade school and was awed by saxophonist Sam Lee's circular breathing.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening
